name: Oneteam
description:
Oneteam's connector gives Claude native access to your Employee Experience Platform, so you can run and analyze your organisation through natural language. Every tool operates on one organisation you belong to.

Organisations & people: List your organisations and their structure (communities, teams, function groups). Create communities, teams, and function groups in bulk. Invite new members by email and assign them to communities and function groups.

Feed & messaging: Publish or schedule organisation messages to everyone or a targeted audience. Read the social feed and search it, and pull the comments and replies on any post to analyze how people responded.

Academy & onboarding: Create academy courses with content and quiz modules, update modules and screens, and translate a course into other languages. List and inspect courses, read learner feedback, and track completion — starting, progressing, finished, and overdue — organisation-wide or per course, down to individual users.

Documents: Browse every document folder as a flat, path-labelled list and create knowledge-base pages from Markdown or HTML.

Reports & analytics: Query engagement metrics and user counts over time, per-community statistics, performance reviews, and survey results. A built-in reporting guide walks Claude through multi-step report flows so summaries stay accurate.

Forms & surveys: List forms and surveys and read submissions, with answers resolved to human-readable values.

Perfect for onboarding new hires, keeping frontline teams informed, spinning up training, and turning platform data into clear reports — all from the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Oneteam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Oneteam to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.oneteam.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Oneteam MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oneteam lists 25 MCP tools, including create_academy_course, create_document_page, create_organisation_message, create_organisation_structure, get_academy_course, get_academy_progress, get_analytics, get_course_feedback, get_feed_messages, get_form_submissions, get_message_comments, and get_organisation_structure.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Oneteam?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Oneteam in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Oneteam requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Oneteam is developed by Oneteam. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
